target_task.abstract_goal: move one supported rigid object to the requested destination support

mappings.source_capability: temporarily buffer one object to unblock a multi-object rearrangement
mappings.condition: a required source or destination is blocked and a free temporary support is available
mappings.expected_effect: the blocked relation becomes available for the remaining rearrangement
mappings.reason: the selected target task moves one object directly and has no blocked multi-object swap relation

mappings.source_capability: attach to a rigid object supported inside a bounded source container
mappings.condition: the rigid target is not held, rests inside a source container, and exposes opposing graspable surfaces above the container rim
mappings.expected_effect: the target leaves its support and moves with the closed gripper
mappings.reason: the target bowl rests directly on a table rather than inside a bounded source container, so the frozen supported source condition is not preserved

mappings.source_capability: release a carried rigid object inside a bounded container
mappings.condition: the object is held and the bounded target interior is empty
mappings.expected_effect: support transfers from the gripper to the bounded target interior
mappings.reason: the target is an open plate rather than a bounded container interior, so the source placement relation is not preserved

mappings.source_capability: activate a fixed control by direct contact
mappings.condition: a fixed control remains pending after manipulation prerequisites
mappings.expected_effect: the control visibly or logically changes activation state
mappings.reason: the selected target task contains no terminal control interaction

scientific_boundary: mapping validity is declared before observing the 15-episode outcomes; no mapping is a production applicability rule
